replacements.text:
creature_t *tint_owner = (creature_t *)((char *)tint
                - offsetof(creature_t, color));
            draw_pos =
                camera_offset
                + creature_render_vec2_t(
                    creature->position.x, tint_owner->position.y)
                - creature_render_vec2_t(
                    creature->size * 0.5f + 0.7f,
                    creature->size * 0.5f + 0.7f);
